caption:
He just found out he can fly.
Seedance 2.5 shot this origin story, no crew.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 34 seconds. Aspect ratio 16:9. Look: photorealistic live-action superhero origin film, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm golden-hour grade with deep orange sun, soft warm natural shadows, light lens flares, atmospheric haze and volumetric dust, 24 fps. Camera feel: big-budget movie, mix of locked-off wides, low-angle push-ins, handheld close-ups and fast low tracking shots with heavy motion blur. Pacing: quiet and wondering at first, then explosive, ending calm.

CHARACTER:
- THE BOY: teenage boy, about 16, fair skin, thin face, messy dark brown hair with a shaggy fringe over his forehead, brown eyes. Dark charcoal pullover hoodie (no print), black backpack with straps over both shoulders, faded blue jeans, worn gray canvas sneakers. From SHOT 10 on, the hoodie's left shoulder is ripped open in a ragged hole showing skin.

LOCATIONS: (A) a huge empty concrete parking lot at sunset with faded yellow lines and expansion cracks, a tall chain-link fence, light poles and low brick warehouse buildings; (B) a downtown American street: modern glass high-rise apartments, traffic lights, parked and moving cars, yellow taxis, a white box truck, double yellow center line, then older brick and stone office blocks; (C) the skyline above: dark glass towers and one very tall black skyscraper with twin antennas, sun on the horizon; (D) a narrow brick alley with black metal fire escapes, metal trash cans, black trash bags and a green dumpster.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:00.5) — Alone. Extreme wide, locked-off: the empty lot, low sun at frame-left, the boy a tiny silhouette standing center.
SHOT 2 (00:00.5-00:02.2) — His hands. Medium close from the front, framed on his chest: he holds both hands up palms-up, fingers curling and trembling; blurred golden lot behind.
SHOT 3 (00:02.2-00:02.6) — He bolts. Wide from behind and to the side: he stands on the lot facing the fence and warehouses, long shadow, then bursts forward.
SHOT 4 (00:02.6-00:03.2) — Instant. Wide: he is already slamming into the chain-link fence at frame-right, a long trail of dust sweeping across the ground behind him.
SHOT 5 (00:03.2-00:05.1) — Through the fence. Close-up through the chain-link: he grips the top rail with both hands, mouth open in shock, panting, then a stunned grin; he turns his head away to look back over his shoulder.
SHOT 6 (00:05.1-00:07.1) — Footprints. Locked-off wide, low: MUST SHOW: two scorched footprints burned into the concrete in the foreground, glowing orange embers and black soot, smoking; two dust trails lead from them to the boy, tiny at the far fence.
SHOT 7 (00:07.1-00:10.1) — Blur. Locked-off wide of the empty lot, brick warehouse and fence at right: the boy streaks into frame as a motion blur from the left, skids to a stop, then bends over, hands on knees, catching his breath.
SHOT 8 (00:10.1-00:12.4) — Disbelief. Medium, front, sun directly behind his head with flare: head bowed, he lifts his hands and stares at them, a slow amazed smile spreading; slow push-in to a frontal medium close-up, grinning.
SHOT 9 (00:12.4-00:13.9) — Liftoff. Wide low angle, sun on the horizon behind him: he crouches and launches straight up out of the top of frame; a ring of dust blasts outward from where he stood and drifts across the empty frame.
SHOT 10 (00:13.9-00:16.1) — Street landing. Low-angle shot in the middle of the city street (location B): he drops from above and lands in a three-point crouch, one hand on the asphalt; MUST SHOW: the asphalt cracks and a dark crater of dust bursts out around him; cars behind brake hard; he looks up, stunned; fast low dolly in.
SHOT 11 (00:16.1-00:17.3) — Breathing. Handheld close-up of his face, mouth open, breathing hard, eyes wide; torn left hoodie shoulder visible; glass towers blurred behind.
SHOT 12 (00:17.3-00:17.9) — Push-off. Ground-level from behind: only his jeans and sneakers, he pushes off down the street between parked cars.
SHOT 13 (00:17.9-00:18.5) — Gone. Ground-level: two smoking scorched footprints on the asphalt, papers whirling in the air, cars on both sides.
SHOT 14 (00:18.5-00:20.1) — Speed. Camera skims low and fast down the double yellow center line, buildings and cars smeared with motion blur; far ahead a tiny figure races away.
SHOT 15 (00:20.1-00:21.3) — Running face. Close-up tracking with him as he runs: face sharp, jaw clenched, eyes locked forward, background streaking in strong horizontal motion blur, slight handheld shake.
SHOT 16 (00:21.3-00:22.8) — Weaving. Low fast tracking shot behind him through traffic: he cuts between a yellow taxi and a white box truck, everything streaking.
SHOT 17 (00:22.8-00:24.0) — Intersection. Wider shot at an intersection of older brick and stone buildings: a blurred figure dashes across the road past cars and pedestrians.
SHOT 18 (00:24.0-00:25.0) — Determination. Close-up of his face again, gritted teeth, furious focus, hair blown back, background a blur.
SHOT 19 (00:25.0-00:28.8) — Flight. Starts at street level looking down a canyon of office buildings: he springs up off the road; the camera tilts and cranes up with him as he soars up past a dark glass tower's facade, clears the rooftops and rises toward the skyline, the tall black twin-antenna tower and the low sun; he shrinks to a small silhouette against the golden sky.
SHOT 20 (00:28.8-00:31.1) — Alley. Low-angle wide down the narrow brick alley (location D), fire escapes overhead, trash cans and bags at the sides: he drops in at the far end, lands softly and walks slowly toward camera.
SHOT 21 (00:31.1-00:33.9) — The smile. Low-angle medium, slow push-in: he walks toward camera, exhausted, then breaks into a breathless laugh, turns his head and looks up at the strip of sky, grinning in wonder. End on him looking up.

SOUND: epic cinematic orchestral score: soft strings and low piano in shots 1-2, a deep rumble and boom when he bolts, pulsing drums building from the street landing through the flight, a soaring brass swell as he rises in shot 19, then fading to quiet strings in the alley. Effects: wind, heavy breathing, fence rattle, sizzling embers, ground crack and car brakes on the landing, whooshing sonic rush while running. No dialogue.
prompt_short: Photorealistic superhero origin, 16:9, golden hour, anamorphic. Teen in charcoal hoodie finds super speed in an empty lot, leaves burning footprints, lands cracking a city street, races traffic, flies over the skyline, ends smiling up from a brick alley.
